claim_boundary: PMO pilot AUC and endpoint values are early downstream outcomes. This ladder tests charged temporal selection across held-out oracle tasks. Prospective RxnFlow environment selection requires measurements made before target optimization.

evaluation.cost_contract: Every released replicate of every candidate is charged through the pilot budget, followed by completion of the pilot-AUC-selected method.
evaluation.final_outcome: mean AUC Top-10 through 10,000 oracle calls
pilot_measurements: AUC Top-10 through the pilot budget
endpoint Top-10 at the pilot budget
fraction of the pilot budget producing unique molecules

source.name: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization
